name: N1
summary:

It combines two arms with the company’s CooWAM world-model system for interpreting tasks, planning actions and interacting with people. description.en:
N1 is Kuwa/COOWA’s full-size humanoid built on its Nexus platform. It combines two arms with the company’s CooWAM world-model system for interpreting tasks, planning actions and interacting with people. The official profile specifies an approximate 1.75 m height, a maximum 30 kg single-arm load and a maximum 50 kg dual-arm load.

Kuwa describes autonomous movement, dynamic obstacle avoidance, balance recovery and getting up after a fall. Interchangeable hands or specialized tools support handling, sorting and assembly, while dual batteries permit powered battery swaps. Target settings include commercial properties, industrial material movement and infrastructure inspection.
